SELECT 
    t1.devregistry AS device_id,
    t1.makername AS manufacturer,
    t1.modnum AS model,
    t2.usbpwrline AS calculated_ber_value
FROM 
    DeviceIdentity AS t1
JOIN 
    TestSessions AS t2 ON t1.devsessionref = t2.sessionregistry
WHERE 
    CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(t2.usbpwrline, 'W', ''), 'V', '') AS NUMERIC) > 7.5;
